introduction: New Hampshire weatherization arranges home-efficiency improvements through local Community Action Agencies. The household application and property assessment are separate stages.
description: New Hampshire weatherization arranges home-efficiency improvements through local Community Action Agencies. The household application and property assessment are separate stag

sections.who: Income-qualified owners and renters may be considered. Renters need landlord permission, and local providers assess the property and prioritize available funding.
sections.get: An energy audit identifies suitable measures such as insulation, draft sealing or selected heating-system work. Approved services are improvements to the home rather than cash for any repair you choose.
sections.docs:
• Income and household records requested by the agency.
  • Your address and energy bills.
  • Owner or tenancy information.
  • Landlord contact and permission if renting.
sections.apply:
1. Contact the CAA serving your town

    Use the state’s local intake guide.

  2. Request weatherization explicitly

    In Hillsborough and Rockingham, the provider uses a Fuel or Electric Assistance application and requires a yes answer to the weatherization-interest question. Ask your own agency about its form.

  3. Arrange assessment

    If selected, allow the audit and confirm the work authorized for the property.
sections.after: Ask about waiting-list status and whether income certification needs renewal while waiting. After work, keep the provider’s inspection and maintenance instructions.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using State weatherization and local application overview, Hillsborough and Rockingham weatherization intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is fuel assistance required before weatherization?
The state brochure says you need eligibility certification but do not have to accept a fuel benefit.
Yes, subject to eligibility and landlord permission.
Does an audit promise every listed improvement?
No. The property assessment and available funding determine the approved measures.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
